introduction: Mississippi SNAP helps eligible households buy groceries. Apply through Access MS or request an application from the county MDHS office.
description: Mississippi SNAP helps eligible households buy groceries. Apply through Access MS or request an application from the county MDHS office.

sections.who: MDHS checks household circumstances, income and applicable eligibility rules. A pre-screen is optional and is not an eligibility decision.
sections.get: Approved households receive food benefits through EBT. The amount depends on the case.
sections.docs:
• Identity, address and income evidence.
  • Housing and other allowable expense records.
  • Additional records requested by the caseworker.
sections.apply:
1. Submit the application

    Use MDHS’s SNAP application instructions. You need not complete a pre-screen or gather all documents first.

  2. Complete any required interview

    Follow the caseworker’s appointment instructions.

  3. Send verification

    Submit requested information on time and keep receipts.
sections.after: Read the decision and reporting instructions. Ask the county about urgent food needs.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using SNAP application process. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Must all proof be gathered before applying?
No. MDHS explicitly says it is not required.
Can I get a paper application?
Follow the caseworker’s instructions for any required interview.
